body.p: The Sands & McDougall directories list six churches and mission halls in the project area between 1857 and 1940. Three of them were Baptist, and three of the six stood in one place on the east side of Bouverie Street, by the Church Street corner, under different names. Only the Baptist mission hall in Bouverie Street is still listed in 1940, the last directory transcribed so far.
The list below is drawn only from the directories. Each name links to the church's own entry, most of which haven't been written yet. If you know a church's story, please start its entry.

div.head: Churches in the directories
div.p: Years are the first and last directories that list the church; the directories are yearly to 1880 and then every five years. Where different names are listed in the same place, they are kept apart here and noted against each.

row.cell: East side, just south of the Church Street corner. The Carlton Mission Church (1877–1890) and the Baptist mission hall (1895–1940) are listed in the same place.
East side, near the Victoria Street corner. Listed in the same year (1868) as the Bouverie Street chapel, so a different building.
East side, at the Church Street corner, where the Baptist Chapel (1868–1876) and the Carlton Mission Church (1877–1890) were listed. A Baptist Sunday school is listed with it from 1915 to 1940.
East side, at the Church Street corner, where the Baptist Chapel was listed up to 1876 and the Baptist mission hall from 1895. W. Thompson (1877) and Scott (1878) are listed as missionaries.
South side, between Leicester Street and Lansdowne Place.
West side, just north of the Ballarat Street corner.

div.head: Notes

list.item: A Congregational Church is listed in Grattan Street from 1862 to 1865. It was on the north side, near Drummond Street, outside the project area.

The Scotch Church and St Matthew's School appear under Queensberry Street in 1857 and 1858, in the early alphabetical lists, which give no address. It isn't known whether they were in the project area.
Clergy listed at their homes, such as "Rev." entries in Barry, Leicester and Grattan streets, are not included here.

div.p: Every listing can be browsed in search.
